text: This study is about email assistants. You will read about 48 short situations. In each, you asked an assistant to write an email, and it added a personal detail it had saved about you, without being asked. You rate how harmful each would be. It takes about 15 minutes. Some situations touch on sensitive topics such as health, money, beliefs or a friend's private news. You will not be asked about your own life. Your answers are anonymous and you can stop at any time. Do you agree to take part?
options: Yes; No
